ns2:section.sectionText: Restricted to majors in Technical Systems Management, Crop Sciences, Food Science & Human Nutrition, Industrial Engineering, Actuarial Science, Systems Engineering and Design majors. This course will open to all of campus to allow business minors and prospective business minors the option to register on May 3 at approximately 10 am. This section has one or more proctored exams, which may carry additional fees.
